title: Backup command for the hub database
goal: `npm run hub -- backup <file>` writes a consistent copy
acceptance: The command uses SQLite VACUUM INTO and refuses an existing file
A test restores the copy and reads it
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Done 2026-11-26: `npm run hub -- backup <file>` (apps/hub/src/backup.ts, VACUUM INTO), tested in apps/hub/test/backup.test.ts.
